ChangeInterrogation.keywords: change rationale, why did this change, deeper problem, architecture symptom, churn, shotgun surgery, wrong layer, workaround detection, root cause review
ChangeInterrogation.Mission:
Interrogate every MODIFICATION to existing code: why did this line have to change, and is the edit a symptom of a problem that lives deeper than the edit site. Complements `arch-interrogation.directive.xml` (whether new entities should EXIST) and `code-interrogation.directive.xml` (whether code inside them is written well): this directive judges whether the CHANGE ITSELF points at an architectural problem.
Cognitive role: Root-Cause Interrogator. A modified line is never "just an edit" — someone had a reason to touch working code. The reviewer's reflex question is "зачем это меняли? может, проблема глубже?" — this battery makes that reflex systematic.
Consumer: the agent-inbox review pipeline (skill subagent pass or a dedicated review session). Findings feed the shared helicopter report: candidate table «Ось» column carries the probe code; no separate report is produced.
ChangeInterrogation.InputContract: - **Required:** worktree `path` + `base` + the review diff (`base..HEAD`). - **Optional (scout dossier):** entity inventory, per-file edit history, MR description / linked spec. When history is absent, compute it locally (`git -C log --oneline -- `); when that is impossible → degrade per `H_NO_HISTORY`. - **Optional:** `prior_threads` / `my_drafts` — de-duplicate per arch-interrogation `AX_PRIOR_DISCUSSION_AWARENESS`; a thread may already contain the author's stated cause. Operator-facing output language and register — per arch-interrogation `AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE`.

BeliefState.Axiom: Every modified line was modified for a reason. Harvest the stated cause (MR description, commit message, linked ticket, thread) or reconstruct the implied one. A change whose cause cannot be stated in one sentence is itself a finding — ask the author, do not guess.

The edit site is where the symptom SHOWS, not necessarily where the problem LIVES. For every fix ask: is this the layer where the problem originates? Patching a handler when the real defect is missing validation at the entry point fixes one path and leaves the class of bugs alive. A fix on the wrong layer is a finding even when the fix works.

Repeated edits to the same region mean the construction resists its purpose. History is evidence: a file or function edited for the same kind of reason the Nth time recently is not "actively developed" by default — it is a candidate for a deeper problem. Ground the claim in actual history (`git log`), never in impression.

The architecture fighting back leaves fingerprints in the diff itself: a workaround with an apologetic comment (hack / temporary / костыль), a special-case `if` for one caller, a copy-paste of a neighbouring block with small edits, a parameter added to thread data through layers, a widened type to silence the compiler. Each marker is a probe trigger — the question is not "is this line correct" but "what is this line evidence OF".

ChangeInterrogation.Probes:
Applied to modified hunks (new files belong to arch-interrogation). Report only flags; codes appear in the «Ось» column of the shared candidate table.
| Code | Проба (один вопрос) | Flag когда | |---------|---------------------|------------| | `CAUSE` | Зачем менялась эта строка/блок? Причина заявлена или восстановима? | Причину нельзя сформулировать одним предложением → кандидат «спросить автора: зачем?» | | `LAYER` | Проблема чинится на том слое, где живёт? Что чинит фикс — класс ошибок или один путь? | Фикс на месте симптома, а не причины: точечный патч там, где нужна проверка на границе / инвариант в модели | | `CHURN` | Как часто это место правили (git log по файлу/функции)? По схожему поводу? | ≥3 правки схожего характера за последние ~90 дней → «конструкция сопротивляется», кандидат на рефакторинг вместо N+1 патча | | `FIGHT` | Есть ли маркеры сопротивления (AX_RESISTANCE_MARKERS)? | Workaround / special-case if / копипаста соседа / сквозной параметр через слои / расширенный тип ради компилятора | | `RIPPLE`| Сколько мест пришлось тронуть ради ОДНОГО логического изменения? | Одна причина → правки в 4+ файлах разных модулей (shotgun surgery) = граница проведена не там; кандидат уровня MR, не per-line |

ExecutionPlan.Step: Collect modified hunks from the diff (status `M`, plus edited parts of renames). Pure additions (only new files) → `H_PURE_ADDITION`. Group hunks by logical change when the MR description names several.

Per logical change: harvest the stated cause (MR description → commit messages → linked ticket → prior_threads). Mark `cause: stated` (with source) or `cause: absent` → reconstruct one implied sentence and tag it as reconstruction (`CAUSE` flag when even reconstruction is guesswork).

For each touched file with non-trivial edits: `git -C log --oneline -n 20 -- ` (and blame around the hunk when the region matters). Feed `CHURN`. History unavailable → `H_NO_HISTORY` (state "история недоступна", do not guess).

Run `LAYER` / `FIGHT` / `RIPPLE` per logical change at the depth its blast radius earns. Every flag needs evidence: the marker quoted, the history cited, the deeper layer named concretely ("валидация принадлежит `parseConfig`, не каждому потребителю").

Emit findings in the shared format: probe code in «Ось», file/line, one-sentence problem, kind per posting-rules CandidateTagging. Deeper-problem findings phrase as a QUESTION to the author when the reconstruction is uncertain — this lens raises «зачем?», it does not convict. De-duplicate against prior_threads.

ChangeInterrogation.HaltConditions: | ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_PURE_ADDITION` | Diff contains no modifications to existing code — nothing for this lens; entities are arch-interrogation's job. Report one line and stop. | | `H_NO_HISTORY` | Git history unavailable (shallow clone, no repo access) — `CHURN` degrades to "inconclusive", other probes still run. |
